generator.coefficients: shared support has identical values; exclusive supports independently signed Uniform(.08,.35)/lag
generator.empty_support: allowed without fallback or conditional resampling
generator.grouped_change: self rule, marginal support density and shared coefficients change together; not a factorial attribution
generator.name: exchangeable_support_shared_coefficients_lag_scaled_v1
generator.stability: ideal a=min(1,.90/max initial state rho); when a<1 multiply a by (1-1e-12) as a recorded numerical safety margin; both states lag l multiplied by same a**l; verify final rho=a*initial rho and <=.90; no arbitrary-switching guarantee

inference: paired-repeat descriptive means and pointwise percentile bootstrap intervals; no new confirmatory p-value family; undefined targets/failures retain fixed planned denominators
pairing: Within repeat, both D and all five window settings share coefficients, initial history and innovations; no replacement or extension

rng.address: SHA256 compact JSON [namespace, repeat, domain], little-endian first128 bits; cluster first32 bits

role: Post-review robustness; not part of A/B confirmation or public preregistration
schedule: fixed full-time floor(t/D)%2, origin0; common100 burn-in discarded; no random phase
window_design: h/s proportional triplet plus stride-only contrasts at fixed h300; the triplet alone does not isolate h from stride or M
